description: Fetch an item's page again and redo its summary, tags and rating. Use it when a card is empty or stale, e.g. saved behind a login wall or while the page was down; for a link not in the catalogue yet use driftnet_save_link, and to hand in a summary you wrote yourself for a queued item use driftnet_enrich_item. id must be an item outside the trash (restore it first with driftnet_update_item). Kept: the reader's note, favorite, share history and any folder they chose; when no model is available or the model fails, the existing summary is kept too. It makes one page fetch and at most one model call, at most once a minute per item. Fails if the item does not exist, is already being refreshed, or the page returns nothing.

id.description: Item id from driftnet_search_items, a positive integer such as 42

name: driftnet_refresh_item
title: Re-fetch and re-summarise an item
